title: Spellforge Muse
description: A painting shows a female figure with a mask-like face covered in symbols standing beside a large blackboard filled with painted marks and writing. Her hands touch a glowing quill that drips golden liquid while colorful threads flow from her head and body into the dark background filled with floating torn papers bearing painted marks.
prompt: A female figure with a mask-like face covered in symbols stands beside a large blackboard covered in painted writing.
